meta.name: English
cli.usage:
Usage: kx-frame-controller-manager <command>

Commands:
  run                    Run as a resident process (started by the systemd unit)
  status                 Show SteamVR and 27062 reachability, and the serial match for each hand
  list                   List the controllers reported by 27062
  disconnect <target>    Disconnect without a long press. Target is left, right, both, or a serial
  install                Write and enable the systemd user unit and the update timer
  uninstall              Stop and remove the systemd user unit
  update [--auto]        Replace the executable with a newer release, restart the unit, and roll back if it does not start. The update timer passes --auto
  channel [stable|test]  Show the release channel used for updates. Pass stable or test to switch. test also takes prereleases and is meant for developers
  start                  Start the resident process. Use it to bring back a process quit from the settings screen
  stop                   Stop the resident process. Autostart is left as it is
  autostart [on|off]     Show whether autostart is enabled. Pass on or off to switch
  version                Print the version
cli.disconnect_needs_target: Give disconnect one target: left, right, both, or a serial
cli.channel_invalid: channel takes exactly one of stable or test: {argument}
cli.config_invalid: The configuration has errors. Running with the previous (or default) settings:
status.steamvr_unavailable: SteamVR: not connected (not running, or libopenvr_api.so was not found)
status.link_ng: 27062: not reachable. Check that SteamVR is running
status.match_ng: {hand}: the OpenVR and 27062 serials do not match. This hand will not be disconnected
status.power_save_pending: Settings changed by power saving were not restored yet. The resident process restores them when it next connects to SteamVR
disconnect.no_target: No connected controller matches {target}. Nothing was disconnected
disconnect.unconfirmed: {target}: sent the request, but could not confirm the disconnect ({serial})
install.done:
Wrote and started the unit: {path}
Executable: {executable}
install.failed: Failed to enable the unit. Check the systemctl output above
uninstall.failed: Failed to remove the unit. Check the systemctl output above
update.up_to_date: You are on the latest version ({version})
update.unreachable: Could not check for updates. Check the network
update.incomplete: Could not fetch the whole release list, so the latest version is unknown
update.unknown: This is a local build ({version}); updates are not checked
update.disabled: Automatic updates are turned off in the configuration
update.not_due: update.check_interval_h has not passed since the last check
update.config_unreadable: Skipping the automatic update because the configuration could not be read. It resumes at the next check once the configuration is fixed
update.rejected: {tag} failed to start after a previous update, so it is skipped. Run update by hand to install it anyway
update.applied: Replaced with {tag}. The unit is not running, so it was not restarted
update.restarted: Replaced with {tag}, restarted the unit, and confirmed it started
update.rolled_back: Replaced with {tag}, but it did not start, so rolled back to {version}
update.rollback_failed: {tag} did not start and rolling back failed. Reinstall {path}
update.failed: Failed to replace the executable. The current one is left as is
channel.current.test: Update channel: test (for developers; includes prereleases)
channel.unchanged.stable: The update channel is already stable
channel.unchanged.test: The update channel is already test
channel.changed.stable: Switched the update channel to stable. Only official releases will be taken from now on
channel.changed.test: Switched the update channel to test. Prereleases will be taken from now on. With auto-update on, the next check (within 30 minutes) installs them. Run update to install now
channel.waits_for_stable: The running version {version} is a prerelease. It is not downgraded to an older official release; it is replaced when a newer official release comes out
channel.config_unreadable: The config file cannot be read, so the channel was not switched. Fix the config and try again
cli.autostart_invalid: autostart takes one of on or off
service.not_installed: The systemd unit is not installed. Run install first
service.start_failed: Could not start the resident process. Check the systemctl output above
service.stopped: Stopped the resident process. Run start to bring it back
service.stop_failed: Could not stop the resident process. Check the systemctl output above
autostart.current.on: Autostart: enabled (starts when you log in)
autostart.current.off: Autostart: disabled (does not run until you run start)
autostart.changed.on: Enabled autostart. It will start the next time you log in
autostart.changed.off: Disabled autostart. The running process keeps running. From now on, use start to run it
autostart.failed: Could not switch autostart. Check the systemctl output above
error.power_off: Failed to detect the long press
status.dashboard: Settings: the "KxFCM" tab in the SteamVR dashboard
dashboard.disconnect.busy: A previous disconnection is still running
dashboard.disconnect.no_target: No controller to disconnect. A hand whose serial cannot be matched is never disconnected
dashboard.disconnect.note: Press twice to disconnect. A disconnected controller reconnects when you press a button on it
dashboard.field.power_save.enabled: Save power when both are off
dashboard.binding_note: A binding chosen in the SteamVR binding screen takes precedence. Highest priority needs Experimental overlay input overrides
dashboard.rebind_pending: Button changes apply when you close the dashboard
dashboard.power_save_note: Power saving is OFF by default
dashboard.config_errors: The config file has errors; running with the previous settings:
dashboard.save_failed: Could not write the config file
dashboard.update.phase.restarting: Restarting and checking that it starts…
dashboard.update.phase.rolling_back: It did not start; restoring the previous version…
dashboard.update.started: Update started. If there is a new version, the service restarts and this tab disappears for a moment
dashboard.update.start_failed: Could not start the update. Check the log
dashboard.update.not_installed: The service is not installed as a systemd unit, so it cannot be updated from here. Run install
dashboard.update.check.available: Version {tag} is available. Press Update now to install it
dashboard.update.check.unreachable: Could not check. Check your network
dashboard.update.check.incomplete: Could not fetch the whole release list, so it is unclear whether this is the latest
dashboard.update.check.unknown: This is a local build and cannot be compared
dashboard.update.note: Updates run separately from the service and restore the previous version if the new one does not start
config.error.unreadable: Could not read the config file: {detail}
config.error.warn_gap: Keep at least {min} between hold_ms and warn_ms
config.error.brightness_gain: Set brightness_gain to null or a finite value above 0
dashboard.language.note: Auto follows the Steam display language, or the system locale if that cannot be read
dashboard.language.machine_translated: This language was machine-translated. Please report mistakes in a GitHub issue
dashboard.autostart.not_installed: The service is not installed as a systemd unit, so autostart cannot be switched. Run install
dashboard.quit.note: Quitting also removes this tab. It comes back the next time Frame starts (if autostart is on) or when you run the start command
steamvr.description: Turns off Steam Frame controllers with a long press.
